newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel diffs near flat, NYMEX steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel diffs near flat, NYMEX steady.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials showed little movement Monday, holding the price ranges made late last week.
On the NYMEX, August heating oil gained a modest 0.02 cent to end at 52.78 cents a gallon.
In the U.S. Gulf, prompt 54-grade barrels changed hands at 0.05 cent over the August futures, the lower end of Thursday's trading range, according to traders.
Prompt 55-grade jet fuel traded at 0.25 cent over August NYMEX, also near flat with the recent trading range.
